prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need strategy, creative, data science, ads automation, or a mix.

Here are reputable LA-area agencies and providers you should consider (they each have different strengths):

- R/GA — global agency with a strong technology and data/AI practice; good for brands needing tech-forward strategy and product experiences.  
- 72andSunny — LA-based creative powerhouse that blends creative strategy with data-driven campaigns and experiments with AI-driven creative.  
- Wpromote — performance marketing agency (El Segundo/LA area) focused on paid media, analytics and automation; practical use of ML for scale.  
- Tinuiti — performance- and data-driven agency with capability in programmatic, social and ecommerce optimization using advanced analytics.  
- Cortex — LA-based AI platform focused on optimizing social and content performance (good if content optimization is your need).  
- VaynerMedia — large full-service shop with an LA presence; integrates data/AI into creative and performance work for consumer brands.

How to pick the best fit
- Define the primary objective (brand/creative, demand gen, ecommerce growth, retention, personalization).  
- Look for relevant case studies and measurable outcomes in your industry.  
- Check team composition (data scientists/ML engineers + strategists + creatives).  
- Ask about tech stack and IP (do they use off-the-shelf tools, custom models, or generative AI workflows?).  
- Request a pilot or proof-of-concept with clear KPIs and a short timeline.  
- Confirm data privacy/security and compliance practices.  
- Compare pricing models (retainer vs. project vs. performance-based).

If you want, tell me: what industry are you in, what budget range, and what you want AI to do (ads optimization, content generation, personalization, analytics/attribution, chatbot/automation, etc.). I’ll shortlist 2–3 LA agencies tailored to your needs and suggest exact questions to ask them.
